app.RGF0YUdlbmVyYXRvcg.action.Z2VuZXJhdG.source: The strategy for varying template values across generated records; `sequential` adds the record index to numeric values and appends it as a suffix to strings; `random` applies random variations; defaults to `sequential`

app.RGF0YUdlbmVyYXRvcg.action.Z2VuZXJhdG.source: Generation Strategy
How template values are varied

A hash representing a single record whose structure and values will be used as the basis for all generated records; field types are inferred from the template values; each generated record varies the template values based on the record index or randomly

app.RGF0YUdlbmVyYXRvcg.action.Z2VuZXJhdG.source:
A list of field definition hashes, each with keys: `name` (string, the field name), `type` (string, one of: `string`, `int`, `float`, `bool`, `date`), and optionally `desc` (string, field description).

If not provided, a default schema is used with fields: `id` (int), `name` (string), `value` (float), `active` (bool), `created` (date)
app.RGF0YUdlbmVyYXRvcg.action.Z2VuZXJhdG.message:
필드 정의 해시 목록으로, 각각 `name`(문자열, 필드 이름), `type`(문자열, 다음 중 하나: `string`, `int`, `float`, `bool`, `date`) 및 선택적으로 `desc`(문자열, 필드 설명) 키를 가집니다.

제공되지 않으면 `id`(int), `name`(string), `value`(float), `active`(bool), `created`(date) 필드가 포함된 기본 스키마가 사용됩니다.
